results.title: India’s wealth management market set to grow 2.5 times to $436 billion by 2034: Emkay Wealth
results.description: The market is estimated to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 10.6% over the period, with demand for wealth-management services expanding beyond traditional high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) to mass-affluent, affluent, HNI, ultra-HNI, family-office and institutional clients.

results.title: Who is Deepanshu Shokeen, the barefoot Independent candidate set to sweep the DUSU VP contest?
results.description: Shokeen, 21, is an M.A. student in the Faculty of Arts and had broken away with the NSUI shortly before the polls
